validation.entryAge: The graduate must be at least 18 years old in the entry year.
validation.degreeGradeRange: Degree grade must be from 5 to 10.
validation.graduationAge: The graduate must be at least 23 years old on the diploma award date.
validation.oathAge: The graduate must be at least 23 years old on the oath date.
validation.oathAfterGraduation: The oath date must be after the diploma award date.
validation.studyDuration: Study duration must be at least 5 years from entry year.

requiredNotice: All fields must be filled in.
subtitleEdit: Update the graduate’s personal, academic and geographic information in clearly organised sections.

sections.identityDescription: Core personal information and unique record numbers.
sections.academicDescription: Study, grade, graduation and oath information.
sections.originDescription: Select the country and, for Greece, the corresponding geographic hierarchy.
